metadata.title: Clicked like a headless chicken and somehow got a kill? Valorant aim is broken again
metadata.description:
Spam clicked like I was smashing a bug.
Enemy probably uninstalling from confusion.
Pretending this was skill for a hot 0.13 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a glorious mess but kills still sneak in!

Click if your aim is chaos but kills still happen!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
